documents.title: Notice Of The 43Rd Annual General Meeting To Be Held On Wednesday, September 30, 2026 And Annual Report For FY 2025-26.
Intimation Of Closure Of Register Of Members And Share Transfer Books / Fixing Of Record Date
Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Board Meeting In Accordance With SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015

analysis.summary: Setco Automotive Limited released its investor presentation for Q1 FY26, reporting a year-on-year revenue growth of 7.8% to Rs. 178.8 crore and an 11.9% increase in EBITDA to Rs. 21.6 crore. Management highlighted continued robust demand for products, favorable segment mixes, and operational efficiencies across subsidiaries including Lava Cast. The company also detailed its manufacturing capabilities, product offerings across clutches and allied components, and ongoing strategic and CSR initiatives.

guidance.claim: The company expects that profitability will improve in the coming years, driven by stable raw material pricing, superior segment mix, and proactive cost management.
guidance.quote: We expect that driven by stable RM pricing, superior segment mix and pro-active cost management to improve profitability in the coming years

guidance.claim: The MHCV industry is expected to grow at an exponential double-digit growth rate of over 30%.
guidance.quote: MHCV industry is expecting to grow at exponential double digit growth rate of >30%

guidance.claim: Setco sales to OEMs are estimated to be higher than the industry average due to BS-VI channel and pipeline inventory restocking.
guidance.quote:
Setco sales to OEM’s estimated will be higher than the industry average due to 
 BSVI Channel and pipeline inventory restocking/build-back

guidance.claim: Revenue per unit of approximately 25% will remain going forward.
guidance.quote: Revenue per unit of ~25% will remain going forward

demand_outlook.claim: Revenue grew on account of continued and robust demand for Setco's products.
demand_outlook.quote: Revenue from Operations stood at Rs. 178.8 crore in Q1 FY26, as against Rs. 165.8 crore in Q1 FY25, a growth of 7.8% on a year on year basis, mainly on account of continued and robust demand for Setco’s products

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the market is now coming back strongly after being subdued due to the second wave of COVID-19.
demand_outlook.quote: While Q1FY22 has been subdued due to Covid wave-2, market is now coming back to strongly

demand_outlook.claim: As the economy unlocks, fleet utilization will progressively improve and long-delayed repairs will increase clutch demand in the aftermarket in coming years.
demand_outlook.quote:
As economy gets unlocked, fleet utilization will progressively improve and long delayed repairs/over-hauling will 
be needed, resulting in higher demand for clutches in the aftermarket in coming years.

demand_outlook.claim: Due to heavy allocation in the budget for infrastructure, mining, and the rural sector, a sharp rebound in MHCV is expected.
demand_outlook.quote: Due to heavy allocation in budget for infrastructure, mining and rural sector is expected to lead to sharp rebound in MHCV

demand_outlook.claim: OEM production schedules of Q4 FY21 exceed Q4 FY20 and are expected to continue in coming years.
demand_outlook.quote: OEM production schedules of Q4FY21 exceeds Q4FY20. As per available data it is expected to continue in coming years

demand_outlook.claim: Q4 FY21 aftermarket demand and order book is the best ever.
demand_outlook.quote: Revenue grew by ~12% in Q3FY21. Strong order book, Q4FY21 demand/order book is the best ever

demand_outlook.claim: Long overdue replacement of the past has started coming and is expected to continue for the foreseeable future.
demand_outlook.quote: Long overdue replacement of the past has started coming and expect to continue for the foreseeable future

capex_expansion.claim: Planned maintenance capex for Lava Cast is getting completed by H1 FY22 to result in higher capacity utilization.
capex_expansion.quote:
Due to liquidity issues, planned maintenance capex is getting completed by H1FY22 and would result in 
higher capacity utilization

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY26 EBITDA growth was driven by higher sales, favourable segment mix and higher operational efficiencies at LAVA cast and Foreign subsidiaries.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the Q1 FY26 is Rs. 21.6 crore as against Rs. 19.3 crore in Q1 FY25, a year on year growth of 11.9%, mainly on account of higher sales, favourable segment mix and higher operational efficiencies at LAVA cast and Foreign subsidiaries

margins_costs.claim: FY25 EBITDA growth was driven by a favourable sales mix, continued operational efficiencies and the LAVA Cast turnaround.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the FY25 is Rs. 109.2 crore as against Rs. 72.5 crore in FY24, a year on year growth of 50.7%, driven by favourable sales mix, continued operational efficiencies and LAVA Cast turnaround during the financial year

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins showed a large downfall at 2.9% in FY21 due to lower operating leverage and a quarter lag on recovering raw material pricing.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins has shown a large downfall at 2.9% in FY21 due to lower operating leverages and quarter lag on recovering RM pricing

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved fixed cost reductions and savings of over 24% in the last two years.
margins_costs.quote: Already achieved Fixed cost reduction /savings of over ~24% in last two years

margins_costs.claim: Contribution margin in Q3 FY21 was 28.2%, up by 50 bps against 27.7%.
margins_costs.quote: Contribution margin in Q3FY21 at28.2%up by 50bps as against 27.7%

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins improved from 5% in Q3 FY20 to 12.5% in Q3 FY21 due to substantial reduction in fixed costs.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins improved from 5%in Q3FY20 to 12.5% in Q3FY21 up by 750bps (~INR 850 lakhs improvement), due to substantial reduction in fixed cost (down by ~18%)

margins_costs.claim: 9MFY21 variable cost percentage was down by 100 bps compared to the last financial year due to superior mix within OE.
margins_costs.quote: 9MFY21 Variable Cost % age down by 100bps as compare to last Financial year due to superior mix within OE (upsizing and higher realisations & margins/Unit)

margins_costs.claim: Fixed cost rationalization led to savings of about INR 200 lakhs till 9MFY21 for Lava Cast.
margins_costs.quote: Fixed Cost rationalization led to savings of ~INR 200 lakhs till 9MFY21, all plans on track to reach FY18 levels

orders_capacity.claim: Setco continues to retain its market leadership with over 85% market share in the MHCV OEM segment.
orders_capacity.quote: Setco continues to retain its market leadership with >85% market share in MHCV OEM segment.

orders_capacity.claim: The aftermarket segment experienced an unexecuted strong order book of approximately 6 to 8 months of sales.
orders_capacity.quote: Unexecuted strong order book approx. 6-8 months of sales

orders_capacity.claim: The maximum capacity utilization achieved by Lava Cast is only about 52%.
orders_capacity.quote: Teething problems: LowerCapacity utilization (max achieved is only ~52%) and high rejection rates (~17% - 19%).

capital_allocation.claim: The investment proposal with India Resurgence Fund involves moving down the clutch business into subsidiary Setco Auto Systems Pvt. Ltd through a slump-sale process.
capital_allocation.quote: The Investment Proposal involves moving down the clutch business of the company into the subsidiary Setco Auto Systems Pvt. Ltd through BTA (slump-sale) process

capital_allocation.claim: The investment by India Resurgence Fund will be in a combination of non-convertible debentures, compulsorily convertible debentures, and equity.
capital_allocation.quote: Investment will be in the combination of Debentures (NCDs), CCDs and Equity

capital_allocation.claim: The debt restructuring proposal for Lava Cast has been approved and implemented by banks.
capital_allocation.quote: Restructuring proposal of bank has been approved and implemented

risks_headwinds.claim: Lava Cast faced teething problems including low capacity utilization and high rejection rates of 17% to 19%.
risks_headwinds.quote: Teething problems: LowerCapacity utilization (max achieved is only ~52%) and high rejection rates (~17% - 19%).

risks_headwinds.claim: Supply chain constraints affected production during Q3 FY21.
risks_headwinds.quote: Q3FY21 would have been much better, but supply chain constraint has affected the production

risks_headwinds.claim: Frequent lockdowns in foreign countries resulted in lower sales and impacted profitability.
risks_headwinds.quote: Frequent lockdown in foreign countries has resulted in lower sales and impacted profitability

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to complete all formalities regarding the India Resurgence Fund deal in the next 7 to 15 days.
management_commitments.quote: Expect to complete all formalities in next 7-15 days.

management_commitments.claim: Farm tractor clutch business has started with two OEMs and expects to add another 2 to 3 OEMs in this financial year.
management_commitments.quote:
Business started with two OEM’s viz Sonalika and Preet Tractors, expect to add another 2-3 in 
this financial year

management_commitments.claim: Management has planned growth strategy for the next 5 years around large and growing aftermarket potential, and initial success in the farm business and exports.
management_commitments.quote:
Large and growing aftermarket potential, initial success in farm business & exports are 
opportunities on which we have planned our growth strategy for the next 5 years.

management_commitments.claim: The company is on track to bring down fixed costs by more than 20% over FY19 levels.
management_commitments.quote: On track to bring down the fixed cost by ~>20% (~INR 18crs) over FY19

management_commitments.claim: Farm equipment sales started with 2 OEMs, and expect to start with a few others in the next 3-4 months.
management_commitments.quote: Farm equipment : Sales started with 2 OEM’s, expects to start with few others in next 3-4 months

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
